items.title: Pokemon to Release First-Ever Valentine’s Day TCG Set!
items.sentence: We can exclusively reveal that Pokemon will release a new "Pokemon TCG Valentine's Box" on January 27th!

items.title: 30+ Pokemon European Space Agency and Other TCG Accessories Released on Pokemon Center!
items.sentence: To celebrate Pokemon's new partnership with the European Space Agency (ESA), the Pokemon Center has released a new batch of TCG accessories featuring Pikachu and other Pokemon in space: “Pokemon ESA” Playmat Zip Binder...

items.title: “Delta Reign” Preorders Now Live on Pokemon Center!
items.sentence: Preorders for select Delta Reign products are now available on the Pokemon Center: Pokemon Center Elite Trainer Box (limit 2) Booster Bundle (limit 1) Booster Box (limit 1) The set officially releases on November 6th.

items.title: All 429 “Deluxe Pack Mega” Cards Revealed for “Pocket!”
items.sentence: A new update to Pokemon TCG Pocket has revealed all the cards from Deluxe Pack Mega!

items.title: “Delta Reign” Prerelease Promos and More English Cards Revealed!
items.sentence: The prerelease promos from Delta Reign have been revealed: Masquerain, Magmortar, Enamorus, and Kommo-o!

items.title: McDonald’s Pokemon TCG Promotion to Launch in November for 30th Anniversary!
items.sentence: We can exclusively reveal McDonald's will be running a Happy Meal x Pokemon TCG promotion in the United States from November 5th to December 9th!

items.title: New Pokemon TCG Premium Binders to Release Featuring Numbered Pokedex Slots for All 1,025 Pokemon!
items.sentence: Starting October 16th, Japan's Pokemon Centers will release a collection of nine Pokemon TCG binders themed after each generation -- with numbered card slots for every Pokemon from #001 to #1025!

items.title: “Deluxe Pack Mega” Annual Special Set to Release in “Pocket!”
items.sentence: A new special set, Deluxe Pack Mega (B4b), will be available in Pocket from September 30th through October 29th.

items.title: Exclusive Zubat, Golbat, and Crobat Promos to Release at Pokemon Leagues for Halloween!
items.sentence: From October 1st to October 31st, Pokemon League players can earn exclusive Zubat, Golbat, and Crobat promo cards!

items.title: Maushold, Morpeko, Salamence ex, Sylveon ex, and More Illustration Rares Revealed from “30th Celebration!”
items.sentence: Multiple Illustration Rares and Special Illustration Rares have just been revealed from 30th Celebration!

items.title: Crystal Lugia, Magikarp, Dark Tyranitar, and More Revealed from “30th Celebration!”
items.sentence: Lugia from Aquapolis, Dark Tyranitar from EX Team Rocket Returns, and Magikarp from Paldea Evolved have been revealed from the Classic Collection of 30th Celebration!

items.title: “MEGA x MEGA Parade” High Class Pokemon TCG Set to Release in February!
items.sentence: We can now reveal MEGA x MEGA Parade (MEGA x MEGA パレード) will release in Japan on Friday, February 19th!

items.title: “Team Rocket’s Ambition” First Cards Revealed for “Pocket!”
items.sentence: The next Pocket set will be named Team Rocket's Ambition (B4a) and will release on August 26th.

items.title: “Charizard Collector’s Figure Box” to Release in China Featuring Jumbo Charizard Figure and Card!
items.sentence: It will include a jumbo holo card of Charizard from 30th Celebration, a sculpted figure emulating Mitsuhiro Arita's artwork, and 15 booster packs of 30th Celebration.

items.title: New Pokemon TCG “Deck Crafter’s Collection” to Release in October!
items.sentence: Similar to a Trainer's Toolkit, the product will provide Trainer staples to make a competitive deck.

items.title: “Eevee & Friends: Dream-Illustrating Figures” Fully Revealed for China!
items.sentence: After initially teasing it, Pokemon China has now fully revealed its next set of TCG figures featuring the Eeveelutions, called "Eevee & Friends: Dream-Illustrating Figures." It will release on August 7th.

items.title: “Ruler of the Skies” First Cards Revealed for “Pocket,” Introduces New Deck Sharing Feature and Higher Rarity Pulls
items.sentence: As revealed a month ago, the next Pocket set will be named Ruler of the Skies (B4) and will release on July 30th.

items.title: “30th Celebration” Additional Product Preorders Live on Pokemon Center!
items.sentence: Following last week's initial drop, preorders for additional 30th Celebration products are now available on the Pokemon Center: Mini Tin Display (limit 1) Booster Bundle (limit 3) The set's first products will release on September 16th.

items.title: “Gem Pack Vol 6” to Release in China Featuring Apple Pokémon!
items.sentence: China will be releasing their sixth " Gem Pack " series booster pack on August 7th!

items.title: New Gengar “Enhanced 2-Pack Blister” and Mega Greninja Mini Portfolio to Release in October
items.sentence: It'll come with two booster packs and a metallic coin.

items.title: “30th Celebration” Preorders Now Live on Pokemon Center!
items.sentence: Preorders for select 30th Celebration products are now available on the Pokemon Center: Pokemon Center Elite Trainer Box (limit 2) Alolan Exeggutor Tech Sticker Collection (limit 1) Lucario Tech Sticker Collection (limit 1) Knockout Collection (limit 1) The set officially releases on September 16th.

items.title: Mega Golisopod ex, Wishiwashi ex, and Another Split Stadium from “Storm Emeralda” Revealed!
items.sentence: Several cards have just been revealed from Japan's Storm Emeralda set, which releases on July 31st.
